business_summary: Paliburg Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the hotel ownership and operation businesses in Hong Kong, Mainland China, and internationally. The company operates through seven segments: Property Development and Investment; Construction and Building Related Businesses; Hotel Operation and Management and Hotel Ownership; Asset Management; Financial Assets Investments; Aircraft Ownership and Leasing; and Others. It develops, sells, and leases properties, as well as offers estate agency services; provides development consultancy, project management, and construction engineering services, as well as property management, security systems and products, and other software development and distribution; and owns, operates, manages hotels. The company also engages in asset management services; trading of financial assets; owning and leasing of aircrafts; provision of financing services; sale of food products; operation and management of restaurants; and provision of housekeeping and related services. In addition, it is involved in financial assets investment and nominee services; lighting technology; mechanical and electrical engineering; management services; retail shops operation; security and guarding services; passenger service licenses holding and vehicle ownership; trademark holding; and room reservation services. The company was formerly known as Paliburg Development Limited and changed its name to Paliburg Holdings Limited in August 1995. Paliburg Holdings Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Causeway Bay, Hong Kong. The company operates as a subsidiary of Century City International Holdings Limited.
business_summary_ko: Paliburg Holdings Limited는 자회사와 함께 홍콩, 중국 본토 및 국제적으로 호텔 소유 및 운영 사업에 참여하고 있습니다. 회사는 7개 부문을 통해 운영됩니다: 부동산 개발 및 투자; 건설 및 건축 관련 사업; 호텔 운영 및 관리, 호텔 소유권; 자산 관리; 금융 자산 투자; 항공기 소유권 및 임대; 및 기타. 부동산을 개발, 판매 및 임대할 뿐만 아니라 부동산 중개 서비스도 제공합니다. 개발 컨설팅, 프로젝트 관리, 건설 엔지니어링 서비스는 물론 자산 관리, 보안 시스템 및 제품, 기타 소프트웨어 개발 및 배포를 제공합니다. 호텔을 소유, 운영, 관리합니다. 회사는 또한 자산 관리 서비스에도 종사하고 있습니다. 금융자산 거래; 항공기 소유 및 임대; 금융 서비스 제공; 식품 판매; 레스토랑 운영 및 관리; 가사 및 관련 서비스 제공. 또한 금융 자산 투자 및 지명자 서비스에도 참여합니다. 조명 기술; 기계 및 전기 공학; 관리 서비스; 소매점
